hypothesis: Preserve the frozen V16B cross-sectional score and causal evidence chain, but neutralize portfolio ex-ante BTC beta at portfolio construction so that performance depends more on cross-sectional winner-minus-loser dispersion and less on residual market direction.
rationale: V16 is intended to be a long-short cross-sectional engine. A structural challenger should first test market-neutrality quality without using future V16B outcomes or external Delta returns for parameter selection.
